name: 33616 · Tampa, FL
findings: ZIP 33616 (Tampa) has 25 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33616 (Tampa) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 33616 (Tampa) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 24% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 25 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
